messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up: Q1 compliance tidy-up — SOC2/ISO evidence collection window opens today. Please read the checklist and upload items by end-of-day next Fri (5 business days). Links below.

Alex (Eng): Got it — where should infra logs go?

Maya (People Ops): Put infra logs and runbooks in the evidence-repo (Confluence page) and upload any large archives to the secure S3 bucket linked on the checklist. Tag files with `compliance:Q1-2026` and the owning team name.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Quick question: retention scope — do we need full 90-day raw traces or just post-incident summaries?

Priya (Legal): For SOC2 we prefer summaries + the associated raw traces for any incident that impacted auth/availability during the quarter. If in doubt, include the raw and we can advise.

Jon (Platform): I'm missing the checklist invite — can someone re-share?

compliance-bot: Automated reminder: Checklist and upload links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/pages/evidence-repo and S3 upload instructions: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/compliance-s3. Deadline: 2026-03-30 23:59 UTC.

Alex (Eng): Dropping a short upload plan here: create folder `eng/ingest/Q1-2026/`, put `svc-logs.tar.gz` and `runbooks/` inside. I'll handle the first upload tomorrow morning.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Alex. Two requests: (1) Owners, please add a single Slack-thread comment under the Confluence checklist confirming uploads, (2) If you need temporary help bundling artifacts, ping people-ops and we'll triage. :handshake:

Priya (Legal): Reminder: any items containing customer PII must be redacted or submitted via the secure form. Do not upload PII to the public evidence pages.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Copy. We'll redact and use the secure upload. One more ask — can we get a short template for incident summaries?

Maya (People Ops): Yup — here's the one-line template to paste into the checklist comment:
```
Summary: <what happened>
Impact: <who/what affected>
Root cause: <short cause>
Mitigation: <what was fixed>
Owner: <team/person>
Artifact: <link to logs/attachment>
```

Alex (Eng): Thanks — that helps. I'll post the `svc-logs.tar.gz` link once uploaded.

Priya (Legal): Also logging the audit: please ensure any role changes in IAM for the quarter are documented (policy changes or temporary perms). We'll need the IAM change request IDs.

Jon (Platform): I'll export the IAM change log and drop it into `platform/compliance/changes_Q1-2026.json` by EOD Wed.

Maya (People Ops): Awesome. Last note — trainings: if you haven't completed the privacy + security quick cert, it's now overdue for anyone who joined before Jan 1. Running list on the Confluence checklist. :clipboard:

Sam (Eng-SRE): Done this morning. Marked in the sheet.

Alex (Eng): Marked as well.

Maya (People Ops): Great — thanks everyone. If anyone hits blockers uploading evidence or needs help with redaction, DM me or ping `@people-ops`. We'll run a drop-in upload session tomorrow 10:00-11:30 PT in #help. :calendar:

Jon (Platform): Will join the drop-in.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: 48-hour warning on 2026-03-28 23:59 UTC.
